Questions
What people usually ask before they start using the library.

  

    
Yes. Every component is free for personal and commercial projects under the MIT licence, so you can use, change and ship it in client work.

    
The HTML, CSS and JavaScript for that component. It needs the shared core once, which holds the tokens, icons, sound and small helpers, and you can copy that from the code view.

    
React and Tailwind versions are in progress, and you can follow them on the roadmap. Sign up and you will get them as soon as they land.

    
Webflow and Framer exports are coming soon. Until then the HTML version works in a Webflow embed or a Framer code component.

    
Two visual styles for the same components. Blueprint is technical and square with an orange accent, Soft is rounded with pastel colours, and both work in light and dark mode.

    
They work with a keyboard, use proper roles and labels, and respect reduced motion. Test them in your own product too, since accessibility depends on how they are used.

    
Every week. Each release is listed in the changelog, and subscribers get it first.

    
Yes. Suggest it on the roadmap and upvote the ones you want, and we build the most wanted first.

    
The team at DesignMe, a design and development studio working with startups and enterprises. If you need help building your product, you can book a call with us.
